titulo_video: The Inheritor: The Limit of Intimacy and an Unexpected Surprise

locucoes.text: Joo Inhyuk is visibly shaken, trying to control his breathing as he apologizes for what happened.
PHEW... ...SORRY.
He leans against the door and covers his face with his hand, processing the whirlwind of emotions from moments ago.
I THINK I LOST MY HEAD.
I must be crazy...
The atmosphere is so thick you can almost feel the tension in the air, man.
He bites the white fabric hard, trying to contain the feelings exploding in this moment.
The environment darkens as an intense energy vibrates everywhere.
At that, Noh Yeseul lets out sounds of total surrender, showing the situation has reached a point of no return.
THANK YOU... MASTER...!
The action continues at full speed, with everything happening at once inside that room.
Joo Inhyuk focuses his eyes on the girl, not hiding how affected he is by all this.
THANK YOU... FOR GIVING ME AN ORDER!
That confession hit way too hard in the conversation, just look at the level of this situation.
Someone outside finds Noh Yeseul's behavior strange, as she no longer seems like the same person.
The intensity increases and sounds of labored breathing fill the entire room.
Noh Yeseul lets out deep sighs, completely given over to that moment of extreme tension.
She continues making short sounds, indicating the situation is getting more and more chaotic.
Man, her breathing is getting visibly heavier and more uncontrolled.
It's one moment after another, without even time to breathe properly.
She lets out a revealing sound, as if she were losing control of her own will.
The two enter a frenetic rhythm of pure physical connection.
Joo Inhyuk observes Noh Yeseul with a fixed gaze, trying to decipher what she's thinking now.
Everything around them seems to disappear as the scene gains an absurd dramatic charge.
...Nng!
My God, her expression reveals the surrender is total.
She closes her hands with impressive force, feeling every second of this instant.
The sound she makes shows the limit was crossed a long time ago.
Noh Yeseul seems to be in a trance, totally focused on Joo Inhyuk.
Do you really want this?
Right after, she questions what he means by that very serious question.
... I WANT TO SEE.
His hand closes in a sign of determination; he's decided what he's going to do.
He confirms that's exactly what he wants to witness.
Noh Yeseul is in total shock, unable to believe what she just heard.
The clock on the wall seems to mark time in a very slow way now.
Bare feet move across the floor, maintaining the suspense of what will come next.
The movement of her leg reveals the vulnerability of the situation, damn.
...OKAY.
The scene escalates in a way we didn't even imagine.
Joo Inhyuk's hand approaches and grabs a piece of her clothing, without hesitation.
Noh Yeseul lowers what remains of protection, making the environment even more charged.
The detail shows her surrender is physical and emotional, wow.
Joo Inhyuk swallows hard, his face completely red with pure nervousness.
She throws the clothing far away, in a gesture showing she wants no more barriers.
The two stand still for a second, facing the result of this sudden decision.
The steps continue toward the final destination of this night, damn.
Joo Inhyuk's gaze is fixed, attentive to every detail of her.
Surprise takes over everything, nobody expected this abrupt change.
WITH THIS... WE'RE THE SAME WAY.
SO...
LET'S CONTINUE.
The comment that they're 'together' in this causes tremendous shock and embarrassment in her.
An absolute silence takes over, interrupted only by onomatopoeia of breathing.
They stare at each other fixedly, as if they were exchanging words without opening their mouths.
...YES.
Outside, the full moon illuminates everything, as if it were watching what's happening in here.
The sound of labored breathing fills every corner of this dark room.
The darkness hides the details, but the audio of the breathing says it all, man.
More labored breathing; the atmosphere couldn't be heavier.
Hands touch quickly, in a clear demonstration of closeness.
Joo Inhyuk comments that all this seems very sudden for them.
Noh Yeseul's face is so flushed it looks like it's going to explode, look at this.
He admits that, looking closely, she really is an incredible person.
The scene continues tense, with a connection that seems almost magical between them.
He repeats that he's impressed with everything he's seeing now.
Joo Inhyuk confesses that her body is something he can't stop admiring.
She feels the weight of his gaze; the vulnerability leaves her without reaction as his assessment becomes invasive.
Their silence speaks louder than any balloon, the tension is palpable.
Hnnh...! Good-
IT'S SO GOOD, MASTER...!
Everything stays in darkness for an instant, focusing only on their feeling.
WHAT DO YOU LIKE ABOUT IT?
IT'S BECAUSE MASTER... IS LOOKING AT ME!
EVEN THOUGH IT'S EMBARRASSING... IT'S SO...
EXCITING!
WHO TOLD YOU... TO CALL ME MASTER?!!
Joo Inhyuk is super nervous questioning this title she insists on using.
I'M LIKE THIS TOO!
SEEING YOU GET EXCITED... IS DRIVING ME CRAZY!
Man, he admitted that her excitement is messing with his head.
Noh Yeseul widens her eyes, totally caught by surprise by his sincerity.
AHH...! SO THAT'S WHAT YOU MEAN.
I'M SO HAPPY... SO HAPPY...!
She can't stop repeating how happy she is, almost in total frenzy.
Her gaze is fixed, almost as if she were suffocating from so much emotion.
Someone lets out a suffocating sound that echoes throughout the entire environment.
She says she can no longer hold back what she's feeling now.
The scene escalates drastically, with emotions overflowing for good.
She screams that she's reached the climax of this intense experience, damn.
Everything seems to tremble as they reach the final limit of the night.
The intensity of this connection is no joke, for God's sake.
The two are exhausted, kneeling on the floor, trying to catch their breath after everything.
The frame is completely dark, as if the world had stopped for a second.
Joo Inhyuk tries to balance himself, moving slightly with exhaustion.
They remain close, exchanging glances after the calm that came after the storm.
A sudden sound breaks the silence of the post-moment; what could it be?
Are you awake?
YOU'RE NOT...
SLEEPING, ARE YOU...?
He stares at the ceiling digesting the confusion of the night, while the emptiness in the room increases his restlessness.
UGH...
He gets up and opens the room door, curious to see how she turned out.
She seems fine...
The shock freezes his movements as he notices something unexpected, changing the course of the decision he needs to make.
I'LL HAVE TO SEND HER AWAY... WON'T I?
He walks holding a garbage bag, as if cleaning the evidence of the night.
His body relaxes with the dawn, relieved to have finally gotten rid of everything.
MY GOODNESS~?
Suddenly, a girl in a cap and mask appears carrying boxes, causing immense surprise in him.
He freezes facing this unexpected visit so early in the morning.
The stranger responds with a calm tone, as if it were something normal, damn.
BUT WHO ARE YOU?
She drops an explosive load about the residence, leaving him totally stunned.
The girl lets out a short 'ah,' and the atmosphere gets even stranger.
At that, someone calls for the professor, and the voice echoes through an environment with lots of fog.
The professor's name is mentioned; could she have been hiding there the whole time?
The girl watches Joo Inhyuk leave; it remains to be seen who she is and if she discovered what happened in the room.
